name: Çalışma Belleği Aşırı Yükü
definition: Canlı ortamda çalışma belleği taşıyor. Dikkat + anlama + karar + hareket aynı anda → çökme.

mechanisms.primary: Limited WM capacity (4±1 chunks) exceeded in live multi-demand situations
secondary: Extraneous load: poor design, anxiety, distraction
Germane load: should be maximized but crowded out
mechanisms.formula: Intrinsic + Extraneous load must not exceed WM capacity

research_sources.finding: WM bottleneck for learning. Minimize extraneous load to free capacity for germane processing.
Schemas in LTM reduce WM burden. Multiple elements → single chunk. Expertise = more chunks.
7±2 chunks in STM. Expert chunking expands effective capacity.
Revised: ~4 chunks in WM. Expert advantage via larger, more complex chunks.
Experts expand functional WM via LTM retrieval structures. Rapid reliable access.
Social evaluative threat reduces WM performance. PFC/IPS activation decreased.
Means-ends problem solving consumes WM. Goal-free problems reduce load, enhance learning.
Mental integration of disparate sources = heavy extraneous load. Physical integration reduces load.
Same info in visual + auditory = redundant, increases load. Choose one channel.
WMC predicts decision speed at ALL expertise levels. Independent of practice.
Expert children recall chess better via chunking, not higher WM capacity.

solutions.name: Extraneous Load Azalt
solutions.protocol: Tek görev. Dikkat dağıtıcı kaldır. İç sesi sustur (script kullan). Multitasking yapma.

solutions.name: Dışsallaştır (Externalize)
solutions.protocol: Düşünmeyi kafandan çıkar: not defteri, if-then plan, kalıp kartı, telefon. WM'yi boşalt.

solutions.name: Chunking / Şema
solutions.protocol: Tekrar eden durumları tek 'chunk'a birleştir. 'Aidat sorusu' = 1 chunk (liste+WhatsApp+bak).

solutions.name: Ön Yükleme (S02)
solutions.evidence: STRONG — reduces intrinsic load in moment
solutions.protocol: Bilgiyi önceden LTM'ye yükle. Anlık WM sadece tanıma + eylem için.

solutions.name: Script (S05)
solutions.protocol: Hazır cümle = 0 WM cost for generation. Ezberlenmiş script kullan.

solutions.name: Kaygı Azalt (S05)
solutions.evidence: STRONG — frees WM from threat processing
solutions.protocol: Sosyal kaygı WM'yi yiyor. Exposure + dışa odak = WM boşalır.

load_reduction_checklist: Ön bilgi yüklü mü? (sıfırdan kodlama yok)
Chunk var mı? (tek birim olarak işle)

interactions.note: WM yükü = tüm sorunların ortak altyapısı. Yük azalt = her şey iyileşir.
